comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your environment
comment_reviews: Directory to watch for new code reviews

devstack.comment: DevStack configuration. lock_timeout in seconds to wait for exclusive access.

testing.comment: Test timeout in seconds. cleanup_on_failure removes test resources even if tests fail.

tracking.comment: Tracks which reviews have been tested in DevStack

filters.comment: Only test changes from these repositories. Empty array = test all. Client libraries and tempest plugins don't need DevStack testing.
filters.comment2: Skip testing changes that are already merged

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).
